elstyleSaver.innerContent:
Change of Grade Policy

A change of grade request cannot be submitted more than one calendar year after the original grade is officially issued.

Important Restrictions

  • A change from a blank grade to a letter grade requires proof of registration and payment.
  • All exceptions require explicit approval from the Academic Dean.
